original_card.question: Can one small, precisely scoped interface lemma be formalized with its actual hypotheses?
methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.
Audit a formal theorem-to-certificate binding independently.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Read the exact hypotheses in the hyperplane-end proof and distinguish Lean theorems from finite supplier assumptions.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: State one missing boundary lemma in full before starting a proof-assistant build.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Does acceptance of the two in-repo HPE checkers supply R' = R, the pre-wrapper equality that factor_iff_pre requires before hpe_word_exact can drop (N)?
scope_change_reason: The card allows one theorem-to-certificate binding. The object is the hrec conjunct of hpe_word_exact against scripts/verify_hpe_lean_binding.py and research/hyperplane-end-lean/code/check_hpe_pairs.py. It does not formalize new arithmetic.
bottleneck_link: hpe_word_exact is an interface between the helper word and Lemma A. A checker that never reads the executed pre-wrapper does not close that interface, even though it does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the synthetic FULL-recipe witness and the two rejection controls. Do not rerun Lean, the external HPE replay, or a supplier.
evidence: Both pinned checkers accept a 38-helper synthetic word whose pre-wrapper records name E:FULL, and still accept when that record is deleted. A phase flip and an h += p gate are rejected. factor_iff_pre and hpe_word_exact's hrec stay in the pinned Lean sources.
author: Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo)
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance in comparing the pinned checkers with factor_iff_pre, the synthetic witness, and the write-up. No proof assistant was used.
